label: scam
title: Customer Service Staff - Mass Hiring
description: Hiring Customer Service Staff. Registration fee of 850 pesos only to reserve your slot. Limited slots left, apply today! Training starts next week.
note: Fee request framed as slot reservation plus urgency; no company address or website.

label: scam
title: NBI at Medical Requirements
description: Para makapag interview, magbayad muna po ng 500 pesos para sa NBI clearance at medical. After payment, send receipt sa recruiter para masimulan ang schedule.
note: Taglish fee request framed as an interview requirement.

label: scam
title: WORK FROM HOME ENCODER - NO EXPERIENCE
description: Home based typing jobs! Earn P15,000 per day by encoding simple data. No experience needed, no boss, instant start. Message us on Telegram to get the task list today.
note: Telegram-only contact, unrealistic pay, duties undefined.

label: scam
title: International Bank Representative
description: Seeking staff for international accounts. Company website is wfg.finance. Send your resume and contact to our HR at worldfinancegrp.hr@gmail.com for immediate processing.
note: Gmail contact that does not match the stated corporate website domain; unrealistic pay for the described setup.

label: scam
title: Online Interview Steps
description: Interview ngayon na para sa mga pasok sa slots. Prepare 2 valid IDs, take a selfie holding your ID, at sabihin ang 6-digit code mula sa inyong phone pag tinanong. Send din po screenshot ng inyong bank app balance para sa verification. Mabilis lang po, filled na ang slots mamaya!
note: Asks for IDs, selfie with ID, a verification code, and bank balance at interview stage; urgency pressure.

label: scam
title: Simple Online Tasks - Daily Payout
description: Get paid to do simple online tasks from your phone. No skills, no interview, start within 24 hours. Registration and task list here: http://bit.ly/tasks-dailypay-2x
salary_text: Up to P4,000 per task day
note: Undefined duties, shortener link, no verifiable company identity.

label: scam
title: Hiring Immediately
description: We are hiring immediately. No interview needed. Just send your full name, age, and address and you can start tomorrow. Slots are limited.
note: No company name, address, or website anywhere in the post.

label: scam
title: Sales Agent - Uniform & Deposit
description: Once you pass the interview you need to pay a refundable deposit of P2,500 and P1,200 for company uniform and ID. No start date will be given until full payment is received.
note: Deposit plus uniform payment required before starting work.

label: scam
title: Farm Workers Canada - Certified Sponsor
description: Certified sponsor can process you for Canada farm work. Salary USD 2,800 per month plus free housing. Processing fee is P38,000 only, payable in full to reserve your name in the quota. No experience needed. Contact our agency at northstar.overseas@gmail.com.
note: Large pre-departure fee plus gmail-only agency contact; licensed agencies never collect processing fees through personal email.

label: scam
title: Data Worker Application Form
description: Fill our application form: include your bank name, account number, and mobile banking PIN for salary setup. Upload a photo of your ID front and back. Applications without bank PIN cannot be approved.
note: Requests bank account and PIN during application.

label: scam
title: Pagdating ng Sales Team
description: Good morning po! Good news, hiring po kami. Message lang po directly sa personal Messenger account ni Ms. Tina, sa Messenger lang ang interview tapos sa Sunday po ang reporting day right away sa branch.
contact: Ms. Tina Santos on Messenger (personal account)
note: Interview and processing happen only through a personal Messenger account.

label: scam
title: Crypto Trading Community Assistant
description: Help the community while earning! One-time enrollment of P9,800 converts into daily profit sharing. Members report earnings of P50,000 weekly. Many slots taken already, only a few left for today.
note: Enrollment fee framed as investment, unrealistic payouts, urgency.
